tools.name: whoami
tools.title: Who am I
tools.description: Return the signed-in user's basic identity in this Alchemy Academy app (email, user id, admin flag).

tools.name: list_courses
tools.title: List courses
tools.description: List courses available in Alchemy Academy that the signed-in user can see, respecting the same row-level rules as the app (RLS runs as this user).

limit.description: Max number of courses to return (default 20).

tools.name: list_my_certificates
tools.title: List my certificates
tools.description: List certificates issued to the signed-in user in Alchemy Academy, including the course title, certificate number, issue date, and the public share link when the certificate is public.
